# Estela Currao — Artista Visual y Arquitecta

> Sitio oficial de Estela Currao, artista visual y arquitecta. Obra contemporánea en escultura, pintura y fotografía.

## About

Estela Currao is a visual artist and architect. Her work spans sculpture, painting and photography, organized in four series: Identity, Rhythmic Matrices, Intersections and Photography (Spaces of Perception).

## Primary URL

- Site: https://estela-monumental-home.lovable.app
